title: The Mystery of the Heavy Little Cube
intro: This quiz follows Zara and Eli as they learn about mass, volume, and density.

questions.prompt: Why was the silver cube heavier than the wooden cube even though they were the same size?
choices: The silver cube had more mass packed into the same volume
The wooden cube was hollow
The silver cube had a larger volume
The wooden cube contained more matter
questions.explanation: The silver cube was heavier because it had more mass packed into the same volume.

choices: How heavy an object feels
How much space an object takes up
How quickly an object moves
How much water an object contains
questions.explanation: Volume measures how much space an object takes up.

choices: The amount of matter in an object
The shape of an object
The color of an object
The amount of space around an object
questions.explanation: Mass describes the amount of matter in an object.

choices: Density = volume ÷ mass
Density = mass × volume
Density = mass ÷ volume
Density = mass + volume
questions.explanation: Density is calculated as mass divided by volume.

questions.prompt: Why did the wooden block float while the rock sank?
choices: The wooden block was colder than the rock
The wooden block was less dense than water, while the rock was denser
The rock had no volume
The water pushed only on the wooden block
questions.explanation: The wooden block floated because it was less dense than water, while the rock was denser.
